shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated pattern near the top
vertical rectangular field filled by the main design
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both surfaces carry shallow-relief profile figures beneath a horizontal band of repeated ornament filling the upper edge, something any relief tradition could produce independently. Otherwise the content differs entirely: A shows a single large, richly draped standing human holding an upright spear, rendered with detailed hair, beard and pleated garment, while B shows stacked registers of small schematic animals (birds, quadrupeds, a long-necked creature) with no human figure and no held object.
